featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited your store today and to my surprise, the cashier opened a sack and added two packets of whole sugar to my bill without asking or informing me. When I questioned this, he said, “It is in offer today.”

I replied, “So what? Many things are on offer  that doesn’t mean you can add them to my bill without asking.

featured_reviews.name: Vivek Bagdi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I even don't wanted to give 1 star also, first learn how to respect the customer.

I recently visited the Reliance Smart Bazaar in Bhayandar, and I must say my experience was extremely disappointing. The management was completely unorganized, and the staff was unprofessional.

I had to wait for more than 40 minutes at the cash counter due to a system issue, which caused unnecessary frustration. Despite this delay, the staff was good no issue bcoz he said sorry and after said pls go on another counter I said okay no problem it's happen after 40 mints wasted but we thought chalo koi baat nhi system problem. However, the worst experience was at the exit gate, where a female staff member treated us disrespectfully.

After billing groceries worth over ₹6,000, there was a minor issue where a water drainage powder worth ₹25 was not billed due to a mistake at the counter. When I tried to clarify the confusion, instead of resolving it professionally, the female staff member at the exit started shouting at us, treating us like thieves. Her loud and insulting behavior was completely unacceptable, and she showed no courtesy or professionalism.

I felt extremely humiliated, and her behavior toward my wife was particularly disrespectful. Such treatment of customers is not acceptable in any retail store, and I urge you to take immediate action against her.

I hope the management will address this issue seriously and ensure that such incidents do not happen again.

featured_reviews.name: Joseph Nunes
featured_reviews.review_text:
Address: Opposite Maxus Mall, 90 Feet Road, Bhayandar West, Thane, Maharashtra 401101
Operating Hours: Open daily from 7 AM to 11 PM

Offers an extensive selection: groceries, household essentials, electronics, apparel, kitchenware, toiletries, linens, and appliances. Known for “Everyday Low Prices,” making it a favorite among budget-conscious shoppers.
Regular deals/promotion events with customers frequently praising discounts, especially in categories like biscuits & snacks.

Spacious layout with well-organized aisles — navigation and product location are easy. Generally clean and hygienic, enhancing the shopping experience.

Checkout queues can get long, especially during weekends and peak hours — a consequence of the store’s popularity.

Parking & Accessibility
Free underground parking for cars is available — a notable convenience. Easily accessible location, close to both Maxus Mall and the local upcoming metro station.

Great value and consistent discounts across product lines Wide variety of products available under one roof
Clean, well-structured store layout and easy navigation
Free, secure parking with trolley availability

Can feel crowded, especially during peak shopping hours or weekends
Occasional issues with pricing labels on shelves
Staff attitude has mixed reviews — majority are helpful, but some incidents noted

Final Verdict
D-Mart Bhayandar West is a dependable one-stop supermarket ideal for daily and bulk shopping. It offers competitive pricing, a broad product mix, and a clean, convenient layout complemented by free parking. While crowds and occasional checkout delays can be a downside, these are balanced out by the value and shopping ease it provides. A smart pick for families and regular shoppers alike—just avoid peak times to skip the rush.

featured_reviews.name: Azra Chaudhary
featured_reviews.review_text:
One stop for all your grocery requirements.
They have changed the settings, cleaning items are shifted to the 1st floor. Generally it's crowded especially between 5:00-9:00 pm and at the month's start. Billing counters have been opened on the 1st floor too. During the festive season the crowd gets big so plan accordingly.

featured_reviews.name: Jayesh Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: The go-to place for groceries and household essentials at unbeatable prices. The store is well-stocked with a vast range of products, from snacks to home decor. It can get extremely crowded, especially during evenings, but the massive savings make the shopping experience well worth the visit.

featured_reviews.name: Prachi Vaishnav
featured_reviews.review_text: Very disappointing experience at . The staff packed items very carelessly. Butter was kept at the bottom of the bag and heavy grocery items were placed on top of it, because of which it got completely crushed and leaked everywhere. By the time I reached home, the entire bag was ruined, groceries were spoiled, and even the auto became dirty because of the leakage. I had to spend so much time cleaning everything. Staff should be properly trained for basic packaging and handling of customer items.

featured_reviews.name: Sanjeev Thakur
featured_reviews.review_text: We frequently visit Dmart in Bhayandar West for our monthly groceries shopping. The store was tidy and they had so many things to buy from. The people who worked there were really nice and helpful. I got what I needed quickly and get in the line and paid easily. They also kept everything clean and safe. I did my groceries shopping and felt really good about it. Dmart is definitely a must-visit for a value-packed shopping spree! Would recommend not to shop during the weekends evening as it get too crowded and also sometime we have to wait for more than 30mins in the line to pay the bill. Also, Do bring your own shopping bags to carry your things so that you don't have to pay for Dmart shopping bags.

featured_reviews.name: Aakash Patil
featured_reviews.review_text: Best place to buy household items at lowest price. It is a quiet busy place so don't visit during peak hours. You can get groceries at much more discounted price than any other. Avoid going on Saturday and Sunday due to heavy crowd.

featured_reviews.name: JIGAR PARMAR
featured_reviews.review_text: There appears to be a lack of security checks at the exit, which creates a risk of items being taken without proper billing. Additionally, there is no active supervision on the floor, allowing customers to consume products (such as chocolates or beverages) before completing their purchase. Overall, there seems to be insufficient staff monitoring customer activity, which may lead to potential losses and operational issues.

featured_reviews.name: Alfeeya Siddiqui
featured_reviews.review_text:
Feedback for Recent Visit to DMart Appreciation and Concern

I am writing to share my experience at your DMart store on 9th nov  during the late‑evening peak period. The store was exceptionally crowded, which is understandable given that it was a weekend.

We waited approximately fifteen minutes at Counter 15 for billing, only to be informed that the counter was closed. Counter 14 was also closed, which added to the inconvenience. My father, who is not medically fit to stand for extended periods, was with us, making the situation particularly challenging.

I wish to commend Ashish and Gayatri who, despite the heavy walkins, attended to us at Counter 15 and ensured that our billing was completed efficiently. Their willingness to go the extra mile is greatly appreciated.

However, I was disappointed that the Shift Manager, whom we requested to speak with, did not appear on the floor to address our concerns. Prompt attention from management during such peak times would help improve the overall customer experience.

I hope this can be conveyed our gratitude to Ashish and Gayatri and consider measures to ensure that managerial staff are available to handle customer queries during busy periods.
